channel.title: OpenPipes Demo: Tech News
channel.description: Fictional technology headlines bundled with OpenPipes for demos and testing.

item.title: OpenWeave AI Assistant Learns to Debug Its Own Pipelines
item.description: The OpenWeave team demonstrated an AI assistant that inspects failing data pipelines, proposes patches, and applies them behind a human review gate.

item.title: Rust 2.0 Roadmap Promises Dramatically Faster Compile Times
item.description: Core maintainers outlined a two-year plan featuring incremental codegen caching that cut clean build times by 40 percent in early benchmarks.

item.title: Linux Kernel 7.1 Ships With Built-In Rollback Snapshots
item.description: The new release integrates filesystem-agnostic rollback points, letting distributions undo a bad update without a separate snapshot manager.

item.title: Startup Nimbus Unveils AI Inference Chip That Sips Two Watts
item.description: Nimbus claims its edge accelerator runs mid-sized language models on battery power, targeting drones, wearables, and remote sensors.

item.title: Quantum Cloud Beta Opens to Independent Researchers
item.description: A 256-qubit machine is now reachable through a free tier, with queue priority granted to reproducibility studies and open datasets.

item.title: Draft AI Regulation Would Require Model Audit Trails
item.description: Lawmakers circulated a proposal obliging providers of large models to retain training provenance records and expose them to accredited auditors.

item.title: Browser Makers Agree on a Common WebGPU Baseline Profile
item.description: After a year of interop tests, the four major engines committed to an identical feature floor, simplifying life for game and ML developers.

item.title: Solar-Powered Data Center Runs a Full Week Off-Grid
item.description: An experimental facility in the desert stayed online for seven days using panels and iron-flow batteries, shifting batch jobs to daylight hours.
